preconditions: Empty Session slot on a MIDI track; double-click or Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s). In Arrangement select an empty timespan on a MIDI track and invoke the same command.
contract: Create a MIDI clip in that location. Initial length for double-click, defaults and occupied/audio-slot behavior remain U.

preconditions: Focused Notes editor; toggle Draw Mode with B; click empty grid, then existing note. In inactive Draw Mode double-click empty grid or an existing note.
contract: Draw adds notes; clicking an existing note in Draw Mode deletes it. Outside Draw Mode double-click adds or deletes respectively. Pitch-lock preference confines a draw gesture to one pitch; Alt/Option temporarily reverses pitch-lock behavior.

preconditions: Click empty editor, drag a time span, click a note, Shift-click another note, or press Escape.
contract: Empty click sets insert marker; dragging selects time and contained notes; Enter toggles time/note selection; Shift-click adds/removes a note; Escape deselects. Invert Selection swaps a proper subset with its complement.

preconditions: Enable Find and Select Notes and change Pitch, Time, Chance, Condition, Count, Duration, Scale or Velocity filter parameters.
contract: Matching notes are selected as parameters change; Invert selects nonmatches; Select reapplies current criteria. Pitch matches across octaves. Clicking editor deactivates applied filters and deselects notes. Combining-filter Boolean rules and range inclusivity U.

preconditions: Drag selected note or resize edge with grid on; toggle grid off or use the temporary grid modifier.
contract: Movement is initially free until a grid/offset point, then snaps; original grid offset can be retained. Modifier temporarily reverses grid-enabled state. Snap thresholds, ties and zoom-dependent grid choice U.

preconditions: Select notes, drag or use arrows; paste clipboard notes at insert marker; place a same-pitch new note over an old note.
contract: Horizontal movement changes time; vertical movement changes pitch. Paste begins at insert marker. A new note overlapping the old note start replaces the old note; overlap limited to the old note end shortens the old note. Exact touching-edge and expression collision results U.

preconditions: Drag note edge or use Shift+left/right; choose Duration then Set Length in utilities.
contract: Edge and keyboard changes follow grid unless bypassed. Set Length applies chosen duration to selected notes, or all clip notes if none selected. Fit to Time Range fits selected note starts/ends to selected range. Minimum duration and edge reversal U.

preconditions: Select multiple notes or time; drag a Note Stretch marker.
contract: Selected material scales proportionally; crossing the other marker mirrors note order. Interior pseudo marker stretches/compresses within fixed boundaries without changing outside material. Linked clip envelope timing follows stretch; unlinked envelope timing does not. Exact envelope curve resampling U.

preconditions: Select notes and invoke Deactivate or 0, then 0 again. Edit notes imported from a MIDI file and invoke Undo.
contract: Deactivated notes are muted/grayed; second toggle reactivates. Undo permits return to prior clip state. Editing imported MIDI leaves original file bytes unchanged. Undo grouping for gestures and persistence of history U.

preconditions: Use Split on an intersected note, Chop Note(s) on Grid on selected notes, or Join on same-pitch selected notes.
contract: Split divides into two; command without note selection requires a note intersecting insert marker/spanning time selection. Chop divides according to current grid. Join creates one note per selected pitch and joins MPE envelopes with notes. Conflicting values/gaps/overlap expression interpolation U.

preconditions: Transpose selection; use Fit to Scale with active clip scale; use Invert or Add Interval.
contract: Transpose uses semitones or active scale degrees; octave shortcut transposes by octaves. Fit to Scale moves to nearest scale pitch, with equal-distance ties downward, and is disabled without active scale. Invert flips pitch ordering. Interval slider immediately adds selected-note intervals; with no selection Add Interval applies to all notes.

preconditions: Use Stretch factor, double/halve, Humanize, Reverse or Legato in Pitch and Time Utilities.
contract: Stretch factor changes note duration without changing loop length; double/halve scales targeted note duration, time selection or loop by two. Humanize shifts starts within a quarter-grid division either direction at maximum amount. Reverse flips note-time order; Legato ends notes at next start, final note at loop end. Precise random law and reverse pivot U.

Precise random law and reverse pivot U. | D12/E12; target U |

preconditions: Edit selected velocity marker by drag or numeric entry; draw in velocity lane.
contract: Numeric entry plus Enter sets selected value. Drawing affects notes in traversed grid division, restricted to selected notes if a selection exists. Without selection drawing can affect all notes there. Ramp assigns first/last values and evenly distributes intervening note velocities. Clipping/rounding and same-time ramp tie order U.

Ramp assigns first/last values and evenly distributes intervening note velocities. Clipping/rounding and same-time ramp tie order U. | D12/E13; target U |

preconditions: Invoke Randomize with selected notes or none; set Velocity Deviation on a note.
contract: Randomize changes selected velocities or all notes if none selected, within the stated amount relative to originals. Deviation is a playback-time range; velocity 60 with +20 yields values in 60..80. Double-click a deviated marker resets deviation to zero. Random distribution/seed/repeatability U.

preconditions: Show Chance lane; edit marker by drag or typed numeric value and Enter; use randomize amount.
contract: Chance lies in documented 0..100 percent range. Probability 50 with randomize amount 25 yields 25..75 percent. With no note selection, changing amount alone does not apply; Enter or Randomize applies to all. With selection parameter change applies immediately. RNG law and out-of-range text handling U.

preconditions: Select notes and create Play All or Play One group; remove a member with Ungroup or add it to another group.
contract: One shared probability marker replaces individual markers: diamond for Play All, triangle for Play One. All group notes share trigger decision in Play All; Play One chooses at most one group note per decision, selected randomly when triggered. Adding to a new group removes original membership. Ungroup restores individual markers. Cross-time decision scheduling U.

preconditions: Enable Fold to Notes, or enable scale and Fold to Scale.
contract: Fold to Notes hides unused pitches. Fold to Scale hides out-of-scale rows except those containing notes. Drum Rack without Fold to Notes displays populated-device pad rows. Folding applies globally across clips; it changes visible rows, not note deletion. Scale highlighting is global.
literal_row: | REQ-MIDI-EDIT-017 | Fold and scale display | Enable Fold to Notes, or enable scale and Fold to Scale. | Fold to Notes hides unused pitches. preconditions: Crop Clip with loop brace; Crop to Time Selection; use Duplicate Time, Delete Time or Insert Time.
contract: Crop deletes MIDI outside loop/time selection and creates no new file. These time commands do not change clip start/end or loop-brace settings. Notes crossing crop/cut boundaries U.

preconditions: Select loop brace and Duplicate.
contract: Double loop length, duplicate original loop notes, zoom out as needed, and shift later notes so their distance from loop end is retained. MIDI clips loop by default; disabling loop grays brace. Crossing-edge notes U.

Excess/unlooped-selection fallback U.

Exact variation law U. | D12/T4; target U |

literal_row: | REQ-MIDI-EDIT-033 | Quantize tool | Select notes; set grid/meter, start/end targets and Amount. | Quantize chosen start/end times toward specified divisions, including triplets.
